import sys

# COBOL fixed-point semantics: wide precision, truncation toward zero on store
getcontext().prec = 40

def accept_alpha(field_width: int) -> str:
    """Read one line from stdin, strip trailing newline only, left-justify
    into a fixed-width alphanumeric field (truncate right, pad spaces)."""
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if line.endswith('\n'):
        line = line[:-1]  # strip only trailing newline
    # Truncate on the right, pad with spaces on the right
    if len(line) >= field_width:
        return line[:field_width]
    else:
        return line + ' ' * (field_width - len(line))

def display_alpha(text: str) -> None:
    """Write a line to stdout exactly as given (no extra spaces/newlines)."""
    sys.stdout.write(text + '\n')

def is_numeric_char(ch: str) -> bool:
    """COBOL IS NUMERIC for a single character: true only for '0'-'9'."""
    return '0' <= ch <= '9'

def move_alpha_to_numeric(ch: str) -> int:
    """MOVE alphanumeric (1 char) to numeric PIC 9: digit value or 0."""
    if is_numeric_char(ch):
        return ord(ch) - ord('0')
    return 0

    """Store into PIC 9(2) unsigned: truncate high-order digits (mod 100)."""
    return value % 100

def store_numeric_9_4(value: int) -> int:
    """Store into PIC 9(4) unsigned: truncate high-order digits (mod 10000)."""
    return value % 10000

def store_numeric_9(value: int) -> int:
    """Store into PIC 9 unsigned: truncate high-order digits (mod 10)."""
    return value % 10

def fmt_pic_9_2(val: int) -> str:
    """Format PIC 9(2) for DISPLAY: zero-padded to 2 digits."""
    return f"{val % 100:02d}"

def fmt_pic_9_4(val: int) -> str:
    """Format PIC 9(4) for DISPLAY: zero-padded to 4 digits."""
    return f"{val % 10000:04d}"

def fmt_pic_9(val: int) -> str:
    """Format PIC 9 for DISPLAY: single digit."""
    return f"{val % 10:1d}"

    ws_i = 0                            # PIC 9(2)
    ws_digit = 0                        # PIC 9

    ws_sum = 0                          # PIC 9(4)
    ws_check = 0                        # PIC 9
